part1_desc: 第 1–27 步：跟着苏文读恐龙的百科条目——认 dinosaur、prehistoric 这些词，学扫描找数字和 as...as...，练恐龙数字 245、180、66 和 1,000。
part2_desc: 第 28–50 步：再读一篇恐龙短文独立验证，练 either...or...、some...others... 和 so...that...，学列数字、作比较的写作方法，练写恐龙介绍。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：恐龙条目信息查找（扫描找数字）、必记词汇 dinosaur/prehistoric/completely/ancestor/fossil、句式 as...as.../either...or.../some...others.../so...that...、数字 245/180/66/1,000、写作方法列数字与作比较、主题分类 The living world。Unit 1 Look it up! 主题，核心内容恐龙（约 2.45 亿年前出现、统治地球 1.8 亿多年、约 6,600 万年前灭绝）。

steps.title: 翻译帮·广播站：翻开恐龙条目
steps.teach_html:
广播站继续翻儿童百科全书：苏文翻到了“生物世界”这个主题，找到一篇关于恐龙的条目。

读之前先想好：你要找什么？恐龙什么时候出现？统治地球多久？什么时候灭绝？大的有多大，小的有多小？带着问题去读，读得更快。

这一课我们就读这篇条目，学着用扫描找数字。

steps.title: 翻译帮·必记词汇（一）
steps.teach_html:
先认四个词，都是恐龙条目里要用的：

dinosaur /ˈdaɪnəsɔː(r)/ n. 恐龙。The word “dinosaur” means “terrible lizard”. dinosaur 这个词的意思是“恐怖的蜥蜴”。

prehistoric /ˌpriːhɪˈstɒrɪk/ adj. 史前的。Dinosaurs are prehistoric animals. 恐龙是史前动物。

terrible /ˈterəb(ə)l/ adj. 恐怖的；可怕的。

lizard /ˈlɪzəd/ n. 蜥蜴。

顺带记构词：pre- 是“在……之前”的意思，historic 是“有历史记载的”，合起来 prehistoric 就是“史前的”。

steps.title: 翻译帮·必记词汇（二）
steps.teach_html:
再认四个词：

ancestor /ˈænsestə(r)/ n. （动物的）原始种型；祖先。Dinosaurs are the ancestors of today's birds. 恐龙是今天鸟类的祖先。

fossil /ˈfɒsl/ n. 化石。Scientists learn about dinosaurs by studying fossils. 科学家通过研究化石了解恐龙。

die out 灭绝：Dinosaurs died out about 66 million years ago. 恐龙大约在 6600 万年前灭绝。

completely /kəmˈpliːtli/ adv. 完全地；彻底地。Scientists are not completely sure why. 科学家并不完全确定为什么。

steps.title: 教材帮·阅读策略：扫描找数字
steps.teach_html:
要找数字，不用逐字读完全文。先想好找哪个数字，再快速扫文章，看到数字就停下来，读那一句。

比如找“恐龙什么时候灭绝”，扫到 66 million years ago 就停住；找“统治多久”，扫到 more than 180 million years 就停住。

数字是最容易扫到的东西：眼睛一扫，数字马上跳出来。

steps.title: 教材帮·句式：as...as...
steps.teach_html:
as + 形容词/副词原形 + as，表示“和……一样”。

Some were as small as chickens. 有些恐龙像鸡一样小。

Others were as big as ten elephants. 另一些像十头大象一样大。

记住：两个 as 中间放形容词或副词原形，后面跟比较的对象。否定是 not as...as...，表示“不如……”。

steps.title: 教材帮·句式：either...or... / some...others...
steps.teach_html:
either...or... 要么……要么……；或者……或者……：Dinosaurs walked on either two or four legs. 恐龙用两条腿或者四条腿走路。

some...others... 一些……另一些……：Some dinosaurs ate plants, and others ate meat. 有些恐龙吃植物，另一些吃肉。

others 在这里是代词，指“另外的一部分”，前面不用再加 the。

steps.title: 教材帮·数字读法：million 与 1,000
steps.teach_html:
英语里的大数字：million 是“百万”。245 million years ago 是“2.45 亿年前”；180 million years 是“1.8 亿年”；66 million years ago 是“6600 万年前”。

1,000 读 one thousand，是“一千”：more than 1,000 kinds of dinosaurs 是“1000 多种恐龙”。

记住：million 前面有数字时不加 s，245 million 不是 245 millions。

steps.title: 写作帮·写作方法：列数字、作比较
steps.teach_html:
介绍事物，两个办法最管用：列数字和作比较。

列数字：不说“恐龙生活了很久”，说“恐龙统治地球 1.8 亿多年”——数字一出来，时间多长马上就清楚了。

作比较：不说“恐龙有大有小”，说“有些像鸡一样小，另一些像十头大象一样大”——一比，大小差别马上就看出来了。

以后写介绍动物的文章，也可以用这两个办法：先给数字，再做比较。

steps.title: 练习帮·做笔记：恐龙笔记五项
steps.teach_html:
读完一篇动物条目，随手记五项：生存时期 Time period、体型 Size、饮食 Diets、近亲动物 Animals related to it、科学家不确定的事 Things scientists are not sure about。

恐龙的五项是：约 2.45 亿年前出现、约 6600 万年前灭绝 / 小得像鸡、大得像十头大象 / 有些吃植物、有些吃肉 / 鳄鱼、蛇、蜥蜴和今天的鸟 / 为什么突然灭绝。读的时候就按这五项去扫。

steps.title: 翻译帮·阅读材料：恐龙
steps.teach_html:
下面是一篇儿童百科全书里的条目，介绍恐龙。读两遍，记住关键数字：恐龙第一次出现是什么时候？统治地球多久？什么时候灭绝？大的有多大，小的有多小？

再用一次扫描的方法：问题问数字，就去找数字；问题问大小，就去找 as...as...。

steps.title: 恐龙第一次出现
steps.scene: 恐龙最早是什么时候出现的？
steps.stem: When did dinosaurs first appear?
options: about 245 million years ago
about 180 million years ago
about 66 million years ago
about 1,000 years ago
steps.help: 到恐龙条目里找“第一次”那个句子，里面有个年份。
steps.explain: Dinosaurs first appeared about 245 million years ago. 第一条恐龙大约在 2.45 亿年前出现。

wrong_feedback.B: 180 million 是恐龙统治地球的时间，不是第一次出现的时间。
wrong_feedback.C: 66 million 是恐龙灭绝的时间，不是第一次出现的时间。
wrong_feedback.D: 1,000 年太短了，恐龙是几亿年前的动物。

steps.reading: Dinosaurs were animals from a very long time ago. They were a type of prehistoric animal. They were related to crocodiles, snakes and lizards, and they were the ancestors of today's birds. The first dinosaurs lived about 245 million years ago. They lived on land and walked on either two or four legs. Many of them ate plants, but some of them ate meat. Dinosaurs were not all the same size. Some were as small as chickens, and others were as big as ten elephants. For more than 180 million years, dinosaurs ruled the Earth. Then, about 66 million years ago, they died out. Scientists are not completely sure why. They study fossils, and every year they learn more about dinosaurs.

steps.explain: Dinosaurs lived on the Earth for more than 180 million years. 恐龙在地球上生活了 1.8 亿多年。

common_errors.say: 66 是灭绝的时间，不是统治的时间，再找找“more than”那句。
245 是第一次出现的时间，不是统治的时间，再找找“more than”那句。

steps.reading: Dinosaurs were animals from a very long time ago. They were a type of prehistoric animal. They were related to crocodiles, snakes and lizards, and they were the ancestors of today's birds. The first dinosaurs lived about 245 million years ago. They lived on land and walked on either two or four legs. Many of them ate plants, but some of them ate meat. Dinosaurs were not all the same size. Some were as small as chickens, and others were as big as ten elephants. For more than 180 million years, dinosaurs ruled the Earth. Then, about 66 million years ago, they died out. Scientists are not completely sure why. They study fossils, and every year they learn more about dinosaurs.

steps.reading: Scientists know more than 1,000 kinds of dinosaurs. How do they know so much about animals that lived so long ago? They study fossils. Fossils are old bones and footprints left in rocks. Dinosaurs lived on land. Some were as small as chickens. Others were as big as ten elephants. Many dinosaurs ate plants, but some ate meat. Dinosaurs are related to crocodiles, snakes and lizards. They are also the ancestors of today's birds. About 66 million years ago, dinosaurs suddenly died out. Scientists are not completely sure why. steps.title: 写作帮·用列数字、作比较写一段恐龙介绍
steps.teach_html:
写一段恐龙介绍，两个办法一起用：

先列数字：Dinosaurs first appeared about 245 million years ago. They ruled the Earth for more than 180 million years.

再作比较：Some were as small as chickens, and others were as big as ten elephants.

最后收一句：About 66 million years ago, they suddenly died out.

数字说清时间多长，比较说清大小差别——这样写，介绍就清楚又具体。

wrong_feedback.B: 这句只说了恐龙吃什么，没有数字。
wrong_feedback.C: 这句用了 as...as... 作比较，没有数字。

common_errors.say: 光写 small 不够，要写完整的 as small as“像……一样小”。
这里说的是很多只鸡，要用复数 chickens。

steps.explain: Dinosaurs first appeared about 245 million years ago. 恐龙大约在 2.45 亿年前出现。

common_errors.say: 254 不对，再看一眼条目里的数字，是 245。
180 是统治的时间，不是第一次出现的时间。

steps.title: 哪个 as...as... 是对的
steps.scene: 下面哪个句子里的 as...as... 用对了？
steps.stem: Which sentence uses “as...as...” correctly?
options: He is as tall than me.
She is as tall so her sister.
This dinosaur is as big as an elephant.
They are as smart that monkeys.
steps.help: as...as... 两个 as 中间放形容词原形，后面跟比较对象，逐个检查。
steps.explain: “This dinosaur is as big as an elephant.” is correct. as...as... 中间是形容词原形 big，后面是比较对象 an elephant。

wrong_feedback.A: than 是比较级用的词，as...as... 里不能有 than。
wrong_feedback.B: so 不能放在 as...as... 里，两个 as 之间只放形容词。
wrong_feedback.D: that 不能放在 as...as... 里，第二个 as 后面直接跟比较对象。

steps.title: 哪个 some...others... 是对的
steps.scene: 下面哪个句子的 some...others... 用对了？
steps.stem: Which sentence uses “some...others...” correctly?
options: Some dinosaur ate plants, and others ate meat.
Some dinosaurs ate plants, and others ate meat.
Some dinosaurs ate plants, and other ate meat.
Some dinosaurs ate plant, and others ate meat.
steps.help: some 后面跟复数名词，others 是代词，逐个检查。
steps.explain: “Some dinosaurs ate plants, and others ate meat.” is correct. some 后面是复数名词 dinosaurs，others 指另外的一部分。

wrong_feedback.A: some 后面要跟复数名词，dinosaur 是单数，不对。
wrong_feedback.C: other 是形容词，不能单独做主语；这里该用代词 others。
wrong_feedback.D: eat 后面要跟复数名词 plants，plant 是单数，不对。

steps.title: 本课小结
steps.teach_html:
这一课我们学了：

1. 恐龙：约 2.45 亿年前出现，统治地球 1.8 亿多年，约 6600 万年前突然灭绝；小的像鸡，大的像十头大象；有些吃植物，有些吃肉；近亲是鳄鱼、蛇、蜥蜴和今天的鸟；科学家靠化石了解它们，但并不完全确定灭绝原因。

2. 扫描找数字：问题问数字，就去文章里扫数字。

3. 句式：as...as...（和……一样）、either...or...（要么……要么……）、some...others...（一些……另一些……）、so...that...（如此……以至于……）。

4. 写作方法：列数字、作比较——数字说清时间数量，比较说清大小差别。

5. 做笔记：动物条目记五项——生存时期、体型、饮食、近亲、未解之谜；恐龙归“生物世界”主题。

下节课精讲本课词汇和句式：look through、die out、intelligent、talented 这些词的用法。
